subject: CardioHealth security discovery — SOC 2 materials & portal access
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Torres <etorres@cardiohealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-07-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: CardioHealth security discovery — SOC 2 materials & portal access

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement/security can move forward: 

1) Materials request
   - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) or temporary attestation if final Type II not yet published.
   - Bridge letter confirming scope & controls mapping.

2) Evidence exchange
   - We use a secure Trust Portal for artifact exchange. I can provision an invite scoped to CardioHealth and grant read-only access for your security team and procurement.

3) Vendor questionnaire
   - I've attached a short vendor DDQ (Vendor-DDQ-CardioHealth.xlsx) — if you prefer, we can complete your questionnaire instead.

4) Timeline & next touch
   - If you can share the SOC 2 or attestation by end of next week, we can complete the procurement review in 7 business days.

Attachments included: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2027.pdf (report extract), Redwood-Bridge-Letter-Template.docx (example bridge letter), Vendor-DDQ-CardioHealth.xlsx

I am provisioning a Trust Portal invite now — you should receive a separate email from trust@redwoodinference.com. Please loop in procurement (copied) and let me know if they want a short call to walk through artifacts.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Emily Torres <etorres@cardiohealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cardiohealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CardioHealth security discovery — SOC 2 materials & portal access

Thanks Naomi — helpful summary. A couple quick notes from our end: 

- Procurement would like the full SOC 2 Type II report if available; otherwise the latest interim attestation will work.
- For bridge letters: we prefer vendor-signed PDFs rather than Word docs. If you can provide a PDF, that’s ideal.
- We’ll need a named contact in the portal (security@cardiohealth.com) and procurement will need an SFTP fallback if the portal is delayed.

I’m copying our procurement inbox. Procurement team — can you confirm preferred intake (Trust Portal vs SFTP) and expected timeline for review?

I’m available for a 20-min sync tomorrow 10–10:30am PT if you want to talk through what you’ll upload.

—Emily
Emily Torres
Director of IT Security, CardioHealth
etorres@cardiohealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@cardiohealth.com>, Emily Torres <etorres@cardiohealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-07-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CardioHealth security discovery — SOC 2 materials & portal access

Hi Emily / Procurement —

Great — thanks for the clarifications. Quick responses and what we’ll do next: 

- SOC 2 PDF: attaching the signed Type II report extract (SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2027.pdf). If you need the full underlying report, we can provide it through the Trust Portal.
- Bridge letter: I’ve converted the template to PDF and uploaded it to the portal. You’ll see "Redwood_Bridge_Letter_CardioHealth.pdf" in the invite.
- Portal invite + scopes: Trust Portal invite was sent to security@cardiohealth.com and procurement@cardiohealth.com. Invite link: https://trust.redwoodinference.com/invite/NDK3-CardioHealth
- SFTP fallback: noted — we can enable an SFTP drop for artifacts if your team prefers that channel; let me know and we’ll provide credentials.

Next steps for Procurement (requested):
- Confirm preferred intake (portal or SFTP).
- Complete or share any vendor DDQ you want us to fill. We included Vendor-DDQ-CardioHealth.xlsx as a starter.
- If you want a short walkthrough, Naomi (me) and Ben (cc) can do a 15-min screen share tomorrow at 10am PT.

Ben will own the evidence upload and can provide the secure links. Karhik is on copy for control-scope questions (GDPR/HIPAA mapping).

Thanks!
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@cardiohealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Torres <etorres@cardiohealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CardioHealth security discovery — SOC 2 materials & portal access

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for sending. Procurement prefers the Trust Portal for initial intake; please keep SFTP as a fallback. Our expected review window is 5–7 business days after artifacts are accessible. A couple of asks: 

- Please provide a CSV manifest of uploaded artifacts (filename, date, short description).
- Where relevant, flag any artifacts that contain ePHI and note the retention policy.

We’ll confirm the exact review owner by EOD; for now route correspondence to procurement@cardiohealth.com.

Procurement Team
CardioHealth

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Emily Torres <etorres@cardiohealth.com>, procurement@cardiohealth.com
Date: 2028-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CardioHealth security discovery — SOC 2 materials & portal access

Internal note / action items — posting here so Ben/Karthik have the ask tracked: 

1) Ben: please upload the full SOC 2 Type II (complete report) to the Trust Portal and add a CSV manifest. Mark files that reference ePHI and include the retention policy snippet (we default to 7 years retention for audit artifacts).

2) Karthik: please prepare a short mapping doc (1 page) on GDPR/HIPAA scope for CardioHealth (data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, key management) — attach to portal.

3) Naomi: I’ll send a brief walkthrough invite to Emily/procurement for 10am PT tomorrow (confirming). Also convert bridge letter to signed PDF and attach.

If procurement asks for DocuSign or an NDA, I’ll coordinate with legal.

Thanks — we should be live in the portal by EOD today.

—Naomi
